apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Separate controller-rumble diagnostic build based on 151. Settings → Input → Touch & Controller shows connected devices, iOS haptics availability and motor outputs. Test Controller Rumble sends a short direct pulse without phone fallback or a stream; left/right tests appear where supported. Physical G8+ MFi output is not yet verified. Game rumble behavior is unchanged. Metal 4 remains opt-in/default off; HDR and MetalFX choices remain independent. Device Release build and 332 tests pass. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.
